name: AIT Alert Data Set
provenance: Alerts produced by Suricata, Wazuh and AMiner over the AIT-LDSv2 testbeds; published on Zenodo (record 8263181). Generation code: github.com/ait-aecid/alert-data-set.
citation: AIT Alert Data Set, Zenodo record 8263181, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8263181, published 2023-08-18.

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.notes: Attribution only; verified on the official Zenodo record page (2026-10-19). No NonCommercial/ShareAlike constraint on the alerts (unlike the AIT-LDSv2 raw logs).

access_conditions: Public download from Zenodo; no account required.
redistribution_conditions: Keep raw data under the git-ignored data/external/ (never committed). Redistribution permitted with attribution.
ground_truth: Event-level attack labels over a multi-step scenario (labels.csv).
known_limitations: Synthetic lab testbeds, not production SOC traffic.
Alert volume and class balance depend on the detectors' configuration.
